source.title: NFL Combine (FOOTBALL IS BACK!)  · 2026-09-14

sections.text: Tree Milk led us in a long warm up. We did some sprinting and some stretching and various other fun things.

Quarter 1: Route trees. Pax took turns running routes and throwing the ball as a QB. When a pass was incomplete pax did 5 burpees or 10 merkins (pax choice). Did a few rounds. 

Quarter 2: 20 yard sprint. 5 burpees. 30 yard sprint. 10 jump squats. 40 yard sprint. 15 Big boy sit ups. 

Halftime: 40 yard bear crawl 

Quarter 3: Kicking Drill. Pax took turns attempting to make a field goal through the uprights from the 10 yard line. Difficult in the dark. We made one field goal. Every time we missed we did 15 Carolina Dry Docks. When we made it we did 10. 

Quarter 4: Football Hot Potato. Pax were in a circle in a continuous Al Gore. Pax with the ball threw it to another Pax at random. If caught, that pax chose an xo and led it. If dropped, pax did bonny blaires. We did the following xo's in differing reps: 
Bonny Blaires, pickle pointers, jump squats, squats, imperial walkers, plank jacks, mountain climbers, Arm-o-Rama, LBC's... A few other ones.
Tree Milk led us in a bunch of stretching until recover recover.

source.title: F3 Poker · 2026-08-06

sections.text: Grass grabbers, Michael Phelps, SSH and WMH. Explained the poker game set up.

4 teams of 2. One member of each team would grab a card from the pile and the team would then run to the corresponding sign for that card and do the XO there. Reps were based on the card number. Face cards were 11 reps and aces were 12 reps. Repeat until you had 5 cards. Did allow one trade at the end but still had to do the new XO. 

We compared hands at the end of each round. Winners had 5 burpees and losers had 10 burpees. 

We did two rounds. XO’s as follows:
2’s: bear crawl back to the flag
3’s: lap around goose poop island
4’s: Carolina dry docks
5’s: burpees
6’s: jump squats
7’s: mountain climbers (IC)
8’s: sprint back to the flag
9’s: LBC’s (IC)
10’s: Merkins
Face cards: 11 reps of squats
Aces: 12 reps of SSH (IC)
Mary go round. Each pax led an XO.

MOTHERFEEKS
Based on the https://f3greenwood.org/all/ironpax-challenge/feeks-wod-ipc-2025-week-1, but modified so that instead of increasing one exercise every round, we added a new exercise while keeping everything that came before it. We didn't go the full 100 yards, more like 50 so each down and back was about 100.

Round 1: 2 Blockees + 1 Down and Back
Round 2: 2 Blockees + 4 WW3s + 2 Down and Backs
Round 3: 2 Blockees + 4 WW3s + 6 Derkins + 3 Down and Backs
Round 4: + 8 Goblet Squats + 4 Down and Backs
Round 5: + 10 Curls + 5 Down and Backs
Round 6: + 12 Overhead Presses + 6 Down and Backs
Round 7: + 14 Coupon Rows + 7 Down and Backs
Round 8: + 16 Coupon Lunges (1 is 1) + 8 Down and Backs
Round 9: + 18 Chest Presses + 9 Down and Backs
Round 10: + 20 American Hammers (2 is 1) + 10 Down and Backs

Each round included every exercise from the previous rounds.
